instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: I welcomed them and blamed my scream on a bad dream. I said the old man was away in the country. After showing every room, I brought chairs into his bedroom. You see, I sat right above the body without fear. They talked in a friendly way while I smiled. My head started hurting and I heard a ringing sound. No, it was that low, quick beating once again. I raised my voice, but the beating grew louder, too. I walked about and scraped my chair across the floorboards. They went on talking and smiling as before. The sound kept growing louder and louder. Could you bear that? They heard and knew. They were laughing at me. I could not stand any more. I killed him, I screamed. Pull up the floorboards here. That is the beating of his horrible heart.
